findings.correction: Allow every safe positive read revision for parent/general history while preserving strict task revision ceiling and backend mutation limits.

boundariesReviewed: Complete consumed parent/task shape is checked before pending command, draft or renderer state is reset.
Fresh writes require exact next task and parent revisions and requested action, notes, schedule and outcome at the committed task revision.
Updates bind the known task ID, parent ID, task kind and creation instant to the issued command.
Replays accept the current parent and later task state after STOP, rescheduling, completion or cancellation within the actual backend replay contract.
STOP-only replay accepts unchanged committed task revision and newer restricted parent without a second write.
Terminal completion/cancellation task revisions remain immutable while later parent changes remain readable.
Malformed and mismatched successful receipts retain the same key/payload through later client rejections.
Existing app navigation and request-refresh locks prevent a pending task command from being replaced through the normal UI.
The new browser journey commits through the real API, corrupts only the delivered receipt, checks the same key/payload, and reads stored task identity/revision and parent increment independently.
